title: Pasta alla Norma
author: Lorenzo
description: Sicilian: fried eggplant in tomato sauce, finished with grated ricotta salata.
steps: Fry the eggplant in batches in most of the oil until golden; drain on paper and salt.
Warm the rest of the oil with the garlic, add the tomatoes, crushed, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Boil the pasta in salted water, toss it with the sauce, half the eggplant and the basil.
Serve topped with the rest of the eggplant and the ricotta salata.
